authority.intent: Until materially stronger local hardware is purchased, simplify the process and improve analytical quality without requiring 100% automation.

strategy.name: ASSISTED_HUMAN_IN_THE_LOOP_ANALYSIS_BRIDGE
strategy.objective: Maximize analytical quality and reduce operator friction while keeping deterministic preparation, validation, evidence traceability, certification and publication controls automated.

operating_principles: Automate deterministic work; do not force weak local models to perform judgment tasks.
Use a high-capability interactive LLM as analyst tooling when useful, without making it the authoritative persistence layer.
Keep evidence IDs, packet hashes, schema versions and deterministic validators unchanged wherever possible.
The analyst remains authoritative for judgment and impact assessment.
Only validated/certified persisted artifacts may feed Integration; chat prose is not authoritative.
No analytical defect may be silently repaired by Integration.
Preserve a provider-neutral handoff so the interactive step can later be replaced by local inference without redesigning the research pipeline.

bridge_v0_1.interactive_step: Paste/upload PROMPT.md + TASK_PACKET.json to the chosen high-capability interactive LLM. Request only the structured result contract plus a concise analyst-readable explanation.
capture_controls: no silent normalization beyond frozen contract
bridge_v0_1.repair_loop: If validation fails, generate a minimal repair request containing only failing paths/codes and the frozen constraints. Do not regenerate the research packet or change evidence.
bridge_v0_1.certify_boundary: A successful import is still not publication. Human analytical confirmation and existing stage certification remain required.

normal_case_steps: Paste/upload the generated bundle into ChatGPT or another high-capability interactive LLM.
Review one concise control card and confirm or repair.
operator_experience_target.target_manual_actions: 2-4 deliberate human actions per analytical module rather than manual reconstruction of prompts, packets and validation.

forbidden_by_this_strategy: automatic investment conclusion without human confirmation
using chat prose as canonical Integration input
assuming subscription UI availability equals production API reliability
